  html:

# 1. 问题讨论：
### * 评分标准不一致

不同部门负责人对评分标准的掌握尺度不同，有的宽松有的严格，导致跨部门绩效比较不公平。

### * 分数分布差异大

某些部门平均分偏高，某些部门平均分偏低，导致同样表现的员工在不同部门获得不同分数。

### * 员工不公平感

评分偏差会导致员工产生不公平感，影响工作积极性和团队协作，甚至造成优秀人才流失。

# 2.数据分析案例

## 示例1：基础标准化

```{r}
#| warning: false
# 加载包
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(DT)
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
# 创建示例数据
set.seed(123) # 设置随机种子以确保结果可重现
employee_data <- data.frame(
  employee_id = 1:30,
  department = rep(c("技术部", "销售部", "行政部"), each = 10),
  score = c(
    rnorm(10, mean = 75, sd = 5), # 技术部：平均分75，标准差5
    rnorm(10, mean = 88, sd = 3), # 销售部：平均分88，标准差3
    rnorm(10, mean = 82, sd = 4) # 行政部：平均分82，标准差4
  )
)

# 查看原始数据的基本统计信息
table <- employee_data %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  summarise(
    平均分 = mean(score),
    标准差 = sd(score),
    最小值 = min(score),
    最大值 = max(score)
  )

# 箱线图-原始数据
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
showtext::showtext_auto()
employee_data |>
  ggplot(aes(y = score)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = ''), fill = 'green', width = 0.2) +
  geom_violin(aes(x = ''), fill = 'gold', alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~department) +
  theme_bw()

datatable(table, options = list(pageLength = 10)) %>%
  formatRound(
    columns = which(sapply(table, is.numeric)),
    digits = 2
  )


# 使用dplyr按部门分组应用scale()函数
standardized_data <- employee_data %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  mutate(
    employee_id = as.factor(employee_id),
    z_score = as.vector(scale(score)), # 计算Z-Score
    standardized_score = z_score * 10 + 75 # 转换为百分制（Z=0对应75分）
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 查看标准化后的数据
datatable(
  standardized_data,
  options = list(pageLength = 10)
) %>%
  formatRound(
    columns = which(sapply(standardized_data, is.numeric)),
    digits = 1
  )

# 箱线图-标准化数据
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
showtext::showtext_auto()
standardized_data |>
  ggplot(aes(y = standardized_score)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = ''), fill = 'green', width = 0.2) +
  geom_violin(aes(x = ''), fill = 'gold', alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~department) +
  theme_bw()
```

## 示例2：高级应用 - 多维度评分

```{r}
# 创建包含多维度评分的示例数据
set.seed(123)
multi_dim_data <- data.frame(
  employee_id = 1:30,
  department = rep(c("技术部", "销售部", "行政部"), each = 10),
  工作业绩 = c(
    rnorm(10, mean = 75, sd = 5),
    rnorm(10, mean = 88, sd = 3),
    rnorm(10, mean = 82, sd = 4)
  ),
  工作能力 = c(
    rnorm(10, mean = 80, sd = 4),
    rnorm(10, mean = 78, sd = 5),
    rnorm(10, mean = 85, sd = 3)
  ),
  工作态度 = c(
    rnorm(10, mean = 82, sd = 3),
    rnorm(10, mean = 85, sd = 4),
    rnorm(10, mean = 88, sd = 2)
  )
)

# 定义标准化函数
standardize_scores <- function(data, score_columns) {
  data %>%
    group_by(department) %>%
    mutate(across(
      all_of(score_columns),
      list(z = ~ as.vector(scale(.x)), std = ~ as.vector(scale(.x)) * 10 + 75),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    )) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# 应用标准化函数到多个评分维度
multi_dim_standardized <- standardize_scores(
  multi_dim_data,
  score_columns = c("工作业绩", "工作能力", "工作态度")
)

# 计算综合得分（加权平均）
weights <- c(工作业绩 = 0.5, 工作能力 = 0.3, 工作态度 = 0.2)
multi_dim_standardized <- multi_dim_standardized %>%
  mutate(
    employee_id = as.factor(employee_id),
    综合得分 = 工作业绩_std *
      weights["工作业绩"] +
      工作能力_std * weights["工作能力"] +
      工作态度_std * weights["工作态度"]
  )

# 查看结果

datatable(multi_dim_standardized, options = list(pageLength = 10)) %>%
  formatRound(
    columns = which(sapply(multi_dim_standardized, is.numeric)),
    digits = 1
  )


```

## 3. 实际测试

```{r}
# 从CSV文件读取实际数据
# 假设数据文件包含以下列：employee_id, department, score1, score2, score3
# real_data <- read.csv("employee_scores.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 为了演示，我们使用前面创建的多维度数据
real_data <- multi_dim_data

# 数据预处理 - 处理缺失值
real_data <- real_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    where(is.numeric),
    ~ ifelse(is.na(.), mean(., na.rm = TRUE), .)
  ))

# 数据预处理 - 处理异常值（使用IQR方法）
outlier_treatment <- function(x) {
  q1 <- quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- q3 - q1
  lower_bound <- q1 - 1.5 * iqr
  upper_bound <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr
  x <- ifelse(x < lower_bound, lower_bound, x)
  x <- ifelse(x > upper_bound, upper_bound, x)
  x
}

real_data <- real_data %>%
  mutate(across(c("工作业绩", "工作能力", "工作态度"), outlier_treatment))

# 应用标准化
real_standardized <- standardize_scores(
  real_data,
  score_columns = c("工作业绩", "工作能力", "工作态度")
)

# 计算综合得分
real_standardized <- real_standardized %>%
  mutate(
    综合得分 = 工作业绩_std * 0.5 + 工作能力_std * 0.3 + 工作态度_std * 0.2
  )

# 生成报告
report <- real_standardized %>%
  group_by(department) %>%
  mutate(部门排名 = as.factor(rank(-综合得分, ties.method = "min"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    公司排名 = as.factor(rank(-综合得分, ties.method = "min")),
    employee_id = as.factor(employee_id)
  ) %>%
  arrange(公司排名)

# 保存结果到文件
write.csv(report, "standardized_employee_scores.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 表格

report <- report %>%
  select(employee_id, department, 综合得分, 部门排名, 公司排名)
datatable(
  report,
  options = list(pageLength = 10)
) %>%
  formatRound(
    columns = which(sapply(report, is.numeric)),
    digits = 2
  )

# bar图
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
showtext::showtext_auto()
report |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(employee_id, -综合得分), y = 综合得分)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = department), alpha = .6) +
  labs(title = '员工考核得分', x = '员工id', y = '综合得分') +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'Set2') +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(60, 90))

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(showtext)
showtext::showtext_auto()
report |>
  ggplot(aes(y = 综合得分)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = ''), fill = 'green', width = 0.2) +
  geom_violin(aes(x = ''), fill = 'gold', alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~department) +
  theme_bw()

library(ggridges)
ggplot(report, aes(x = 综合得分, y = department, fill = department)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.4) +
  # facet_wrap(~department) +
  theme_bw()
```

## 员工强制分布测试


```{r}
options(digits = 3)
grade_std <- quantile(report$综合得分, c(0.8, 0.6, 0.4, 0.2))
grade_std

report <- within(report, {
  grade <- NA
  grade[综合得分 >= grade_std[1]] <- 'A'
  grade[综合得分 < grade_std[1] & 综合得分 >= grade_std[2]] <- 'B'
  grade[综合得分 < grade_std[2] & 综合得分 >= grade_std[3]] <- 'C'
  grade[综合得分 < grade_std[3] & 综合得分 >= grade_std[4]] <- 'D'
  grade[综合得分 < grade_std[4]] <- 'E'
  综合得分 <- round(综合得分, 1)
})

datatable(report)
```
